parameters.content:
## Darwin Sessions Ingest (Calendly)
Single writer for research sessions booked through Calendly. Replaces Darwin CD Ingest (Calendly) and PF Calendly Capture once it goes live. The UXR Calendly Booking Webhook stays as it is.

- `session_type = continuous_discovery` if and only if the event type is the CD event (`cdEventTypeUuid` in PF Config, https://calendly.com/d/dz6d-wr6-6bf/research-with-n8n). Otherwise `research`.
- One row per invitee. Cancel and reschedule set `canceled_at` (CD reminder compatibility) and link old and new rows.
- **Store today:** mock data table, plus `supabase_row_preview` = the exact `calendar_research_sessions` row (migration 20261002120000). No Supabase writes yet.
- The Calendly Trigger lives in a separate workflow (production only).

nodeGroups.name: Read and classify
nodeGroups.description: Loads config, flattens the Calendly body, sets session_type (CD only for the CD event), drops unknown events and non-mock emails.

nodeGroups.name: Write session
nodeGroups.description: Reads the existing row and the booking link, decides the final state, builds the Supabase row preview, upserts by invitee.

nodeGroups.name: Link reschedule
nodeGroups.description: For the new booking of a reschedule, marks the old invitee row rescheduled and sets canceled_at.
